items.title: The functor of derivations from a sheaf of rings into a module is representable
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the representability of the functor sending a sheaf of modules to the group of derivations from a sheaf of rings into it (author lemma at source lines 4971-4980, label lemma-universal-module). The proof (source lines 4982-5032) is a complete construction: it sheafifies the free module on the sets of sections, writes the three families of relations defining a derivation in one displayed map, defines the universal module of differentials as its cokernel, obtains the universal derivation from the free generators, and shows by the same calculation that every derivation factors uniquely through it (proof lines 4998-5031). The construction of the cokernel together with the verification of the universal property is the content. H2.
